Name: FactSales
Description: Fact table with one row per imported reseller sales order line, containing dates, product and reseller links, quantities, sales amounts and costs.

Name: DimProduct
Description: Product dimension used to analyze sales by product, category, subcategory and product attributes.

Name: DimReseller
Description: Business-to-business reseller dimension used to group sales by reseller and geography.

Name: DimSalesTerritory
Description: Sales territory dimension used to analyze sales by region, country and territory group.

Name: DimDate
Description: Calendar dimension used to filter and group sales by calendar date and time period.

Name: _Mesures
Description: Central location for approved business measures calculated from FactSales.

Name: ResellerSalesTargets
Description: Optional reseller sales targets table; do not treat target amounts as actual sales.

Name: Total Sales
Description: Total monetary sales revenue, calculated as SUM(FactSales[SalesAmount]). It is not a count of sales orders or units.
Synonyms (Q&A candidates): sales revenue; revenue; turnover; sales value

Name: Total Quantity
Description: Total number of units ordered, calculated as SUM(FactSales[OrderQuantity]).
Synonyms (Q&A candidates): units sold; units ordered; sales volume

Name: Total Cost
Description: Total recorded product cost, calculated as SUM(FactSales[TotalProductCost]). Missing source costs may have been replaced during Power Query cleaning.

Name: Margin
Description: Sales amount minus recorded total product cost, calculated as [Total Sales] - [Total Cost]. This is a monetary amount, not a percentage.
Synonyms (Q&A candidates): gross profit amount; sales margin amount

Name: Margin %
Description: Margin divided by total sales, calculated with DIVIDE([Margin], [Total Sales]). A ratio, not a monetary value.
Synonyms (Q&A candidates): margin rate; gross margin percentage; profit margin percentage

Name: OrderDate
Description: Date on which a sales order was placed; use this date for order-based sales trends.
Synonyms (Q&A candidates): sales date; purchase date; order date

Name: ShipDate
Description: Date when the sales order line was shipped; do not confuse with order date.

Name: SalesAmount
Description: Sales monetary amount on this order line; use the Total Sales measure for aggregation.

Name: OrderQuantity
Description: Number of product units ordered on this sales line; use Total Quantity for aggregation.

Name: TotalProductCost
Description: Recorded product cost of this sales line, following DEV1 source cleaning; use Total Cost for aggregation.

Name: UnitPrice
Description: Unit selling price of the product on this sales line; do not sum this field to calculate revenue.

Name: EnglishProductName
Description: Product display name in English used to group and rank sales by product.

Name: EnglishProductCategoryName
Description: English name of the highest-level product category.

Name: EnglishProductSubcategoryName
Description: English name of the product subcategory.

Name: Color
Description: Product color attribute for segmenting sales.

Name: ModelName
Description: Product model designation.

Name: ListPrice
Description: Product list price attribute, not the realized sales amount.

Name: ResellerName
Description: Business reseller name used to attribute and rank sales by reseller.
Synonyms (Q&A candidates): reseller name; business customer; dealer name

Name: BusinessType
Description: Business classification of the reseller.

Name: DimGeography.City
Description: City associated with the reseller.

Name: DimGeography.EnglishCountryRegionName
Description: Country or region associated with the reseller, in English.

Name: SalesTerritoryRegion
Description: Sales territory region used to compare sales performance by region.

Name: SalesTerritoryCountry
Description: Country associated with the sales territory.

Name: SalesTerritoryGroup
Description: Higher-level grouping of related sales territories.

Name: Date
Description: Calendar date related to FactSales[OrderDate].

Name: Année
Description: Calendar year number. The original French field name is retained to preserve existing model references.

Name: Trimestre
Description: Calendar quarter. The original French field name is retained.

Name: Mois
Description: Calendar month label. The original French field name is retained.

Name: Année-Mois
Description: Year and month label for chronological sales reporting.
